title: Epstein files show interest in people with psi abilities

tellings.quote: provably in the files there there was an interest in people with sigh or empathy or consciousness abilities um by the Epstein network

plain: A man who calls himself a Pentagon whistleblower, Matthew Brown, told podcast host Jesse Michels that the Epstein files show something odd. These are records about the network around Jeffrey Epstein, the financier. Brown says the files prove the network was interested in people said to have "psi" abilities, meaning powers of the mind like psychic sensing, empathy or special states of consciousness, which, if true, would tie powerful people to a quiet hunt for such gifts.
